seed_group.theme: projection trust, record-envelope normalization, and cleanup lifecycle safety
primary_directives: Never treat stale projection visibility as mutation authority.
Enforce explicit freshness and degradation disclosure in dense Orchestrator tabs.
Gate write actions on trusted projections or authoritative runtime revalidation.
Degrade toward record-backed inspection (History/Ledger/detail_ref) when trust drops.
Adopt a shared canonical record envelope for governance/runtime object families.
Keep canonical records distinct from artifacts/rendered outputs.
Model lane/worktree cleanup as lifecycle-aware governance, not a simple delete.

existing_conventions_to_preserve: canonical event fields over GUI aliases

projection_fallback_order: projection inspector -> Ledger/History/exact record via detail_ref

identified_gaps: Docs define canonical vs derived storage but not the resulting UI action policy.
No shared freshness/trust contract is yet applied across Orchestrator tabs.
Wording can imply visibility equals safe action authority.
New governance families risk ad-hoc schemas without a shared envelope.
Without envelope normalization, search/export/ledger/deep-link semantics will be repeatedly re-encoded.
carry_forward_fixes: Define a single projection-trust contract with explicit action thresholds.
Require freshness/disclosure indicators on dense operational tabs.
Standardize mutation-gating with trusted projection or runtime revalidation.
Normalize governance/runtime records with a shared envelope plus family payload blocks.
Maintain strict record-versus-artifact separation while preserving linkability.
Codify lifecycle-safe lane/worktree cleanup with lineage and recovery integrity.
sensitive_points: allowed_action_ids[] validity can collapse when projection trust degrades.
blocked/recovery controls require stricter trust gating than passive display surfaces.
Ledger and exact record inspectors are the stable fallback when projections are degraded.
Unresolved conflict worktrees and safe-point restore targets need durable, exact lineage context.
